text.en:
Section three of Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and seventy-two is hereby amennded to
read as follows:
"Section 3. This Act shall take effect on November first, nineteen hundred and twenty-one: Provided,
however,That the Governor-General may, by proclamation, suspend the effects of this Act for a period not to
extend beyond January first, nineteen hundred and twenty-three."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, January 26, 1922.
